name: Hiremium Smart Applicants Screening
author: hiremium

sections.description:
WP Job Manager on its own only shows an email address or a link when someone clicks “Apply for job” — nothing is recorded. Hiremium Smart Applicants Screening adds the missing piece: a real application form with CV upload, an applicant list for employers, and AI screening that scores every applicant against the job.

Features:

  • Application form with CV upload on every job listing
  • Applicant list inside the employer’s existing job dashboard
  • Statuses (new, shortlisted, interview, rejected, hired), private notes and CSV export
  • AI match score with reasoning and matched / missing skills
  • Best-match sorting, so the strongest applicants are on top
  • Scoring runs in the background — applicants never wait for it
  • Works with the Hiremium API, or with your own AI provider key stored in WordPress connectors

Switching AI scoring off keeps everything else working: applications are still collected and employers keep their applicant list, statuses and notes.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WP Job Manager.
  2. Upload and activate Hiremium Smart Applicants Screening.
  3. Go to Job Listings > Settings > Hiremium Smart Applicants Screening and choose a scoring engine.
